name: @inflexion/api
description: @inflexion/api — public, read-only, cached facade over the @inflexion/subgraph + a few live RPC reads (via @inflexion/sdk) + the engine telemetry sinks. No wallet, no RPC key for consumers. Exposes the five data-moat signals (current snapshot + historical series) with graceful degradation while the subgraph is not yet deployed.
